teacher_single_assignment.name: Teacher Single Assignment Constraint
teacher_single_assignment.description: Prevents teachers from being assigned to multiple rooms in the same time slot
teacher_single_assignment.impact: Ensures teachers aren't double-booked, which is critical for a valid timetable

complexity.explanation: T = teachers, D = days, S = slots, R = rooms
complexity.notes: Scales linearly with number of teachers, days, slots, and rooms

no_overlapping_slots.name: No Overlapping Slots Constraint
no_overlapping_slots.description: Prevents teachers from being assigned to lab and theory slots that overlap in time
no_overlapping_slots.impact: Ensures teachers can't physically be in two places at once when lab slots overlap with theory slots

complexity.explanation: Each lab slot overlaps with two theory slots
complexity.notes: Complex constraint as it must check all possible combinations of lab and theory slots

course_hours.name: Course Hours Constraint
course_hours.description: Ensures each course gets allocated the required lecture and practical hours
course_hours.impact: Critical for educational outcomes - ensures students receive the proper instructional time

complexity.formula: O(T × C × (D × S_theory × R_classroom + D × S_lab × R_lab))
complexity.notes: Most complex constraint as it requires tracking hours across all possible assignments

room_single_assignment.name: Room Single Assignment Constraint
room_single_assignment.description: Prevents rooms from being assigned to multiple teachers in the same time slot
room_single_assignment.impact: Ensures rooms aren't double-booked, preventing scheduling conflicts

complexity.formula: O((R_classroom × D × S_theory + R_lab × D × S_lab) × T)
complexity.explanation: Physical constraint - a room can only host one class at a time
complexity.notes: Must be checked for every room, time slot, and teacher combination

lab_batch.name: Lab Batch Constraint
lab_batch.description: Handles lab capacity limitations by creating multiple batches for large classes
lab_batch.impact: Ensures all students get proper lab time despite lab capacity limits (35 students per lab)

complexity.explanation: Requires calculating batches based on student count and scheduling accordingly
complexity.notes: Classes with 70 students require two separate lab batches, doubling the needed lab slots

lab_batch.example:
For a course with 2 practical hours and 70 students:
- Batch 1 (35 students): 2hrs = 1 lab slot
- Batch 2 (35 students): 2hrs = 1 lab slot
- Total: 4hrs = 2 lab slots needed
